tbesh_html:
1) perfect, complete
1a) complete, perfect
1a1) one who lacks nothing in physical strength, beauty, etc
1b) sound, wholesome
1b1) an ordinary, quiet sort of person
1c) complete, morally innocent, having integrity
1c1) one who is morally and ethically pure

strongs_1890.strongs_def: complete; usually (morally) pious; specifically, gentle, dear
strongs_1890.kjv_def: coupled together, perfect, plain, undefiled, upright.
